exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: the delayed spread makes that ceiling situational

rules.text: A parent-mine explosion throws four micro-mines evenly around the blast edge.
Each micro-mine deals 35% current Damage, has 50% current blast radius, arms in 0.25 s, and expires after 4.0 s.
Micro-mines do not create more mines. Their separate capacity is four times current parent capacity; the oldest expires when exceeded.
A fully used cluster adds 140% parent damage, but the delayed spread makes that ceiling situational.
